WHEN LIFE IS FULL

Making room for your health takes thought.

You have learned what matters to you.

You know how much a good night’s rest can change a day.

Making space for movement, food, water, and recovery still takes thought alongside everything else you do.

Some days have more room than others.

Energy, soreness, sleep, cycle context, and a changing schedule can all affect the choices in front of you.

It helps to have your plan and what you have recorded in view.

Anastasis helps you review what makes sense for today.

See How It Works

HOW IT WORKS

How Anastasis works
Share your goals and circumstances.
Review guidance with context.
Choose a manageable next step.

CONTEXT

1. Start with your life

Your profile and assessments record your goals, equipment, training experience, and circumstances. Daily check-ins add how you feel, so guidance has context.

CLARITY

2. Review your next step

Review your training plan, nutrition targets, and recovery guidance. Saved inputs and check-ins help inform the options you see; you choose what fits today.

CONTINUITY

3. Continue with context

Record what you do and return to your saved progress. A check-in, a drink of water, or the next part of your workout can be enough to begin.

Keep your plan and recorded progress together.
Return to one place for training, nutrition targets, and recovery guidance.
Take the next useful step with the room you have today.

Your next step can fit the day you are having.

WHO IT IS FOR

Built for women who already carry a lot.

Running a business.

Leading a team.

Raising kids.

Managing a household.

Chasing a big goal.

Doing several of those at the same time.

You want to feel strong, energized, healthy, and at home in your body.

You just don’t want taking care of yourself to become another full-time job.

Anastasis is designed to make those choices more manageable.

YOUR STARTING POINT

Make room for a starting point that fits.

You can start without having every detail worked out.

Explore a self-led foundation, compare the support levels, or use five brief questions to find a suggested place to begin.

Start with the Capacity Audit.

About 1–2 minutes. Answer five questions and receive a suggested starting program.

Show Me Where to Start
Compare support levels

h1.text: Find the starting point that fits your life right now.

pages.bodyText:
CHOOSE YOUR PATH

Find the starting point that fits your life right now.

Start with the tools that fit your current capacity, time, and resources. Compare what each path includes, then choose the amount of tracking and daily direction that would be useful to you now.

Explore the Paths
Help Me Find Mine

ONE DESTINATION. THREE STARTING POINTS.

The goal is not to push harder forever.
The goal is refined resilience.

Every path includes assessed training, daily check-ins, recovery guidance, and progress history. Nutrition tools and the way next actions are presented differ by path. Your recorded inputs provide context for the guidance you see.

Anastasis brings training, nutrition tools, and recovery guidance into one member dashboard. Learn more about how Anastasis works.

Review your training plan

Record how you feel

Review recovery guidance

Keep your history together

See your next step

Return when you have capacity

THE PATHS

Which season sounds most like you?

EMBER

Rebuild Consistency

For the woman who knows what she wants, but needs a sustainable structure she can actually follow.

Ember brings your assessed training plan, macro targets, water tracking, and recorded progress into one place. Start with what you can manage and keep a record you can return to.

INSIDE EMBER

• Training based on member assessments

• Macro targets and daily macro totals

• Water tracking

• Basic recovery guidance

• Recorded progress and cycle context

• Foundational assessments

BEST FOR

Women who want a self-led foundation with a clear next step.

Explore Ember

IGNITE

Optimize What Is Working

For the woman who has built some consistency and is ready to refine the details.

Ignite adds food logging and more detail from your recorded nutrition and recovery inputs. Review those details alongside your training plan, with room for the realities of your day.

INSIDE IGNITE

• Assessed training and progress history

• Manual food and barcode logging

• Nutrient detail from recorded foods

• Recovery recommendations

• Progress photo uploads

• User-confirmed posture landmarks

BEST FOR

Women who want food logging and more context for daily decisions.

Explore Ignite

PHOENIX

Remove Friction

For the woman who wants meal recommendations and a more directed daily view.

Phoenix brings the food logging, recovery detail, and photo tools available in Ignite together with meal recommendations and directed next actions. Use your recorded inputs to review a manageable next step.

INSIDE PHOENIX

• Assessed training and progress history

• Manual food and barcode logging

• Meal recommendations

• Directed nutrition and recovery next actions

• User-confirmed posture landmarks

• Recorded nutrition and recovery context

BEST FOR

Women who want a suggested next action alongside their recorded context.

Explore Phoenix

WHAT LIFE LOOKS LIKE INSIDE ANASTASIS

Not another plan to force.
A system to build from.
Your starting point

Enter your profile, equipment, goals, training availability, and member assessments. These inputs help establish your starting plan.

Your daily view

Review your assigned workout, nutrition tools, and recovery guidance. Record what you do and how you feel, at a pace that fits your day.

Your recorded history

Return to saved workouts, check-ins, measurements, and photos to review change over time. Your history reflects what you have recorded.

Your next review

Update assessments when they are due and review your current inputs as your circumstances change. Continue from the information available rather than starting over.

NOT SURE WHERE TO BEGIN?

Take the Capacity Assessment.

The Capacity Assessment asks five broad questions about your energy, overwhelm, time, support, and current season to suggest a starting path. Detailed member assessments follow after enrollment. Review the options and decide what fits your life now.

Help Me Find My Path
Return Home

h1.text: Make a little room for yourself.

pages.bodyText:
THE ANASTASIS SHIFT

Make a little room for yourself.

A forthcoming reflection guide about noticing what works for you, making space in a full life, and choosing manageable next steps.

COMING SOON
Begin with what fits your life.

You already make decisions for a full day. The Anastasis Shift is being developed as a place to pause, consider your own priorities, and think about the routines you want to make room for.

The planned guide explores:
Your priorities
Noticing your patterns
Daily structure
Making room for yourself
Manageable routines
Choosing what comes next
Written with a full life in mind.

You may be balancing work, relationships, family, or a changing schedule. The guide is intended for women who want time to reflect on what is practical and meaningful for them.

The guide is in development.

The Anastasis Shift is not available yet. You can explore the current programs while the guide is being prepared, and decide whether one fits what you want now.

h1.text: Help with your account or billing.

pages.bodyText:
CUSTOMER SUPPORT

Help with your account or billing.
Contact support

For a question about your account or something that is not working as expected, email Anastasis.elite@gmail.com. Include your account email, program, the page where it happened, and any error message. Tell us what you tried, any confirmation you saw, and what still needs checking. A screenshot can help. Keep passwords, payment card details, and private health information out of your email.

Billing help or cancellation

Open Billing & Subscriptions in your account to manage an eligible paid subscription. If billing management is unavailable or you need help with a charge or cancellation, email the same address with “Billing support” or “Cancellation request” in the subject. Include your account email and the date or receipt reference for the purchase. Gifted access has no paid subscription to cancel.

Account billing
